newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS 3-MONTH MONEY MARKET CLAIMS YIELD 1.25 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SWISS 3-MONTH MONEY MARKET CLAIMS YIELD 1.25 PCT.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.250 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.258 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on August 14, raised 794.95 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.685 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on August 7, raised 1,014.55 million and was priced at 99.683 percent.
